description: After analysis completes, the ToolCallTraceSummary is appended to the matching ExperienceRecord via UPDATE; if no matching record exists, a standalone_trace_summary is created for retroactive linking; a periodic job (every 60s) attempts to link standalone records

preconditions.description: A task analysis completes and produces a ToolCallTraceSummary

expectedOutcome.description: The trace summary is stored in experience_records.tool_call_trace_json if a matching record exists, otherwise in standalone_trace_summaries with linked=0 for later reconciliation
